title: A Dual-Pipeline Approach for Quantitative Neuroimaging: Leveraging Retrospective MRI Data and Future qMRI Protocols
summary: This ENRICH cluster project studies a dual approach to quantitative neuroimaging using existing MRI data and future quantitative MRI protocols.
Claude Bajada is a co-investigator in the project, which sits within ENRICH's Good Health and Wellbeing pillar.
